title: react33.config — react33Styles, react33I18n, react33Theme, react33Networking, react33Session
description: Root schema for react33.config.json. Published by @react33/react-config. Optional $schema key, or associate via .vscode/settings.json (json.schemas).

$schema.description: Opcional si el editor ya asocia react33.config.json vía workspace (ver @react33/react-config). Si lo declarás: ./node_modules/@react33/react-config/react33.config.schema.json

react33Networking.description: Generated API registry and client hooks (@react33/react-networking). Paths are relative to react33.config.json.

output.description: Path for apis.generated.ts (createApiRegistry, apis, *Request). Overrides CLI default when --output is omitted.

hooksOutput.description: Optional path for the client hooks module. If omitted, derived from output (e.g. apis.client.generated.tsx next to apis.generated.ts).

runtimeModule.description: Optional module specifier (relative to apis.generated.ts) exporting `apiRuntime: ApiRuntime` with `defineDefinitions(base)`, `load`, and optional `defaults` (registry-wide retries/onRetry/timeoutMs). Single seam between codegen and app-level wiring (session/auth, base-URL overrides, retry policies). See `@react33/react-networking` ApiRuntime type.

apis.description: Map of API name -> { url, headers?, cache?, credentials? }.

react33OpenApi.description: OpenAPI 3.1+ codegen (@react33/react-networking). Paths relative to react33.config.json.

client.description: HTTP client overrides when apis.<scope> is omitted (OpenAPI-first). url comes from servers[0] + basePath.

validate.description: Runtime Zod validation for SDK params/response.

operations.description: Per operationId: fetchOnMount, verbose, initData, validate, security.

react33Persistence.description: Claves y modo de persistencia en browser compartidos por locale (react33I18n) y tema (react33Theme).

cookieName.description: Nombre de la cookie cuando el backend activo es cookie.

localStorageKey.description: Clave de localStorage cuando el backend activo es localStorage.

persistenceMode.description: Backend por defecto si la app soporta ambos.

persistenceEnvKey.description: Env var para sobreescribir persistenceMode (defaults: REACT33_I18N_PERSISTENCE / REACT33_THEME_PERSISTENCE). Debe exponerse al cliente: Vite envPrefix REACT33_; Next NEXT_PUBLIC_* + mismo nombre aquí. Ver docs/persistence-env-client.en.md. "" desactiva override.

allOf.description: Locale: convención de rutas y mensajes (ver @react33/react-i18n).

localesDirectory.description: Carpeta de módulos por idioma (relativa a react33.config.json).

urlLocalePattern.description: Regex (string) sobre pathname; primer grupo de captura = locale.

generatedTypesOutput.description: Ruta del módulo de tipos/constantes generado (p. ej. i18n.generated.ts).

generatedRuntimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime SPA generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia).

allOf.description: Tema: opciones extra de escritura de cookie. defaultTheme suele venir de styles.meta generado.

cookieMaxAgeSeconds.description: Max-Age del cookie de tema (~1 año por defecto).

generatedRuntimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime de tema generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia).

stylesGeneratedImport.description: Import relativo a styles.generated desde el archivo runtime (default ./styles.generated).

react33Styles.description: Paths are relative to the config file directory.

domainsOrder.description: Cascade order (file stems without .css). Overrides alphabetical discovery.

output.description: Output path for the generated .ts file.

excludeStems.description: Stems to skip when auto-discovering CSS files (ignored if domainsOrder is set).

banner.description: First line(s) of the generated TypeScript file.

verbose.description: Log resolved config, fromCss, domain order, and output path.

watch.description: Watch fromCss for changes and regenerate (same as CLI --watch). Use CLI --no-watch to force a one-off run when this is true.

metaSourceStem.description: Which CSS stem provides @theme meta (defaultTheme, cols). Default: tokens, else first domain.

react33Session.description: Session manager + UI runtime (@react33/react-session). Declares static wiring (storage, headers template, retry policy) while keeping un-serializable pieces (refresh, selectors) in the handwritten runtimeModule. Paths are relative to react33.config.json.

strategy.description: Which session strategy to wire. Today only "bearer" is implemented (BearerSessionManager + createBearerSessionLoad). "cookie" and "opaque" are on the roadmap — see packages/session/README.en.md "Strategies side by side".

runtimeModule.description: Module specifier (relative to generatedRuntimeOutput) that exports the un-serializable pieces the strategy needs: for bearer, `selectors: BearerSessionSelectors<Tokens>` + `refresh: (rt: string) => Promise<Tokens | null>`; for cookie/opaque, `selectIdentity` + a `fetchMe` callable. Single seam between the declarative config and your transport (OpenAPI SDK, fetch). **Naming**: this module is framework-agnostic by design (no React), so no `.client` suffix — e.g. `./session.runtime` resolves `session.runtime.ts`.

generatedRuntimeOutput.description: Output path for the generated session module (manager + bridge + apiRuntime partial + SessionProvider/useSession re-exports). Mirrors `react33Theme.generatedRuntimeOutput`. **Naming**: follow the canonical suffix rule — `.client.generated.{ts,tsx}` because the file re-exports `SessionProvider`. Recommended: `./src/api/session.runtime.client.generated.ts`. Codegen not implemented yet — schema reserves the field so apps can declare it now.

bearer.description: Settings consumed by `createBearerSessionManager` + `createBearerSessionLoad`. Ignored unless strategy === "bearer".

storageKey.description: sessionStorage/localStorage key where the refresh token is persisted. Same value that today lives hardcoded in your handwritten `createBearerSessionManager({ storageKey })`.

storage.description: Where the refresh token is persisted. `sessionStorage` (default): per-tab, no cross-tab sync. `localStorage`: persists across tabs and enables the cross-tab subscriber. The access token is always in memory regardless of this choice. See README → "Storage trade-offs".

accessTokenSkewSec.description: Seconds before the JWT `exp` claim to consider the access token expired. Used by `isAccessTokenExpired()` and (when proactiveRefresh is true) by the bridge before each request.

headers.description: Header template merged into each request by `createBearerSessionLoad`. The literal substring `{token}` is replaced with the current access token. Use for non-bearer schemes too — e.g. `{ "X-Api-Key": "{token}" }`.

proactiveRefresh.description: When true, the bridge calls `session.ensureFreshSession()` if the access token is expired AND a refresh token exists, BEFORE attaching the header to the request. Disable to refresh strictly reactively via `onRetry` on 401 — see README → "Why proactiveRefresh + onRetry is safe to combine".

cookie.description: Cookie-only session settings (planned, not implemented yet). Reserved here so apps can plan the migration when the strategy ships.

meEndpoint.description: Path where the client fetches the authenticated user profile (e.g. `/me`). Source of truth for `{ isAuthenticated, identity }` in the snapshot.

logoutEndpoint.description: Path the client POSTs to so the server can invalidate the HttpOnly cookie.

bootstrapOnMount.description: When true, the runtime calls `session.bootstrap()` once on mount so identity is hydrated before the first page render. Set to false if you orchestrate bootstrap manually (e.g. behind a login gate).

cache.description: Optional UX cache so the UI doesn't flash a skeleton on every navigation. The server still owns the truth — a stale cache is corrected by the next 401 → bootstrap reaction.

key.description: Storage key for the cached profile.

retry.description: Registry-wide retry policy emitted as `apiRuntime.defaults.retries` + `onRetry`. Mirrors the recommended combo from the session README — reactive token refresh on 401 with optional body-level branching.

statuses.description: Per-status retry budget — same shape as `RetryBudget` in @react33/react-networking. Example: `{ "401": 1 }` retries once on unauthorized after running `onRetry` (which by default calls `ensureFreshSession`).

tokenExpiredCode.description: Optional body-level error code that distinguishes "refresh eligible" from "revoked". When set, the generated `onRetry` only triggers a refresh if `response.data.code` matches this string or is undefined. Useful when the backend differentiates expired tokens from invalidated sessions.

persistenceEnvKey.description: Env var the build/runtime can read to override `bearer.storage` (or `cookie.cache.storage`). Same env-driven override pattern as `react33I18n.persistenceEnvKey` and `react33Theme.persistenceEnvKey`. Must reach the client — see docs/persistence-env-client.en.md. Empty string disables override.

then.description: Bearer strategy requires the `bearer` block (at minimum `storageKey`).
Cookie strategy requires the `cookie` block (at minimum `meEndpoint`).
